mapper.select: select id,task_level,workflow_status,result_status,actual_finish_time,period_lock_flag,version from lab_task where task_level='week' and execution_status is null and del_flag='0' order by id

select id,task_id,from_status,to_status,result_status,actual_finish_time,actor_id,event_type,reason, task_version,evidence_version,idempotency_key,event_time,del_flag from lab_task_execution_event where task_id=#{taskId} and del_flag='0' order by event_time,id

select id,task_id,issue_code,source_state_json,resolution_status,resolution_code,resolved_by,resolved_time,version,del_flag from lab_task_migration_issue where resolution_status='OPEN' and del_flag='0' order by task_id,id
select count(1) from lab_task_migration_issue where resolution_status='OPEN' and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update lab_task set execution_status=#{executionStatus},execution_version=execution_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{taskId} and execution_version=#{expectedExecutionVersion} and period_lock_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select config_value from sys_config where config_key=#{configKey} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_config set config_value=#{newValue},update_by='commitment-cutover',update_time=sysdate() where config_key=#{configKey} and config_value=#{expectedValue}
mapper.select: select from lab_task t where t.carried_from_id=#{carriedFromId} and t.period=#{period} and t.del_flag='0' limit 1
mapper.update: update lab_task set execution_status=#{toStatus},result_status=#{resultStatus}, actual_finish_time=#{actualFinishTime},result_desc=#{resultDesc},fail_reason=#{failReason}, next_action=#{nextAction},current_block_flag='0',current_block_start=null, execution_version=execution_version+1,version=version+1, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{taskId} and execution_version=#{expectedExecutionVersion} and execution_status=#{fromStatus} and period_lock_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
